title: TAPR：一种任务感知的提示重写器，用于提升LLM性能
summary: TAPR是一种任务感知的提示重写器，通过强化学习（GRPO）训练，将用户提示重写为任务优化提示，以提升下游LLM性能。在问答、摘要和算术推理等任务上，基于Phi-4-mini-instruct的TAPR在Natural Questions和GSM8K等基准上取得一致提升。
summary_en: TAPR is a task-aware prompt rewriter trained with GRPO to reformulate user prompts into task-optimized ones, improving downstream LLM performance. It shows consistent gains on benchmarks like Natural Questions and GSM8K using Phi-4-mini-instruct.
